business.name: PuzzleVault Experiences
business.tagline: Immersive escape rooms for groups, corporates, and thrill-seekers.
business.cancellation_policy: Full refund if cancelled 24 hours before the slot. No refund for cancellations within 24 hours. Rescheduling allowed up to 12 hours before the slot, subject to availability.

rooms.name: The Pharaoh's Curse
rooms.description: Unravel the secrets of a buried pharaoh's tomb before the curse claims you. Great for first-timers.
rooms.age_restriction: Suitable for ages 10 and above. Under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.

rooms.name: Operation Blackout
rooms.description: You are undercover agents with 60 minutes to defuse a global threat. Communication and teamwork are critical.
rooms.age_restriction: Suitable for ages 14 and above. Under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.

rooms.name: The Last Signal
rooms.description: A distress signal from a dying space station. Your crew has 75 minutes to restore power and escape. Our hardest room — only 20% completion rate.
rooms.age_restriction: Suitable for ages 16 and above. Not recommended for people with claustrophobia.

rooms.name: Heist at the Grand
rooms.description: Plan and execute the perfect casino heist before the vault resets. Cunning over brawn.

pricing.standard: Priced per person per room. See individual room listings.

corporate_packages.description: Custom packages for groups of 10 or more. Includes dedicated game master, post-game debrief, and optional catering tie-ups.
corporate_packages.price_note: Corporate pricing is custom-quoted. Contact us directly for a quote.

birthday_packages.description: Birthday group bookings include a complimentary decoration setup and a group photo with props.
birthday_packages.surcharge: No surcharge. Standard per-person pricing applies.

discounts.student_discount: 15% off with valid student ID. Applicable on weekdays only.
discounts.returning_customer: 10% loyalty discount for repeat bookings. Mention previous booking at checkout.

faqs.question: Can I book for a team of 2?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Pharaoh's Curse accepts groups as small as 2 players. Most other rooms require a minimum of 3–4 players.

faqs.question: Is photography allowed inside the rooms?
faqs.answer: Photography is not allowed inside the rooms to preserve the experience for future players. However, we take a complimentary group photo at the end of your session outside the room.

faqs.question: What if we get stuck?
faqs.answer: Your game master monitors the session and provides hints via an in-room screen or intercom. You can request up to 3 hints per session.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Free parking is available in the building basement for up to 2 hours.

faqs.question: Are the rooms wheelchair accessible?
faqs.answer: The Pharaoh's Curse and Heist at the Grand are wheelchair accessible. Operation Blackout and The Last Signal involve multi-level movement and are not suitable.

faqs.question: Can we bring food or drinks?
faqs.answer: Outside food and drinks are not permitted inside the rooms. We have a small café area in the lobby where you can eat before or after your session.

faqs.question: What is the best room for beginners?
faqs.answer: The Pharaoh's Curse is our beginner-friendly room and is the best starting point for first-timers.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift vouchers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Gift vouchers are available in denominations of ₹500, ₹1000, and ₹2000. They can be purchased via our website or WhatsApp.
